In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
family screening is a reasonable practice for patients with a positive family history of IAs.
family screening should be performed in patients with multiple first-degree relatives with IAs or subarach-noid hemorrhage, especially when aneurysms are found at a young age.

family screening should be offered to all first-degree relatives of patients with an IA, and screening should start at age 18.
